title: ChatGPT Work is going to completely change how you get work done...
description:
ChatGPT Work is here, and it is going to completely change the way that you get work done.

Because this is not just another ChatGPT update that gives you slightly better answers.

It is a completely new way to use ChatGPT for the larger projects that normally require you to jump between different apps, files, websites, and documents.

You can connect the tools where your work already lives, give ChatGPT a specific outcome, and let it handle the research, planning, analysis, and creation required to get there.

That could mean reviewing your emails and calendar before creating a complete meeting brief.

Analyzing a spreadsheet and turning the findings into an executive presentation.

Researching an entire market and organizing everything into a report.

Or taking a project plan and turning it into an interactive website your team can actually use.

And for more complicated projects, you can start in Plan mode so ChatGPT reviews the available information, asks questions, and shows you exactly how it plans to complete the work before it begins.

The key is to stop giving ChatGPT isolated instructions and start describing complete outcomes.

Tell it what you need created, who it is for, which sources it should use, what it should leave unchanged, and when it needs to ask for your approval.

I put together a complete tutorial showing you how to set up ChatGPT Work, connect your apps, write better prompts, use Plan mode, and turn your best workflows into scheduled tasks.
